Source: The introduction of antibiotics as first-line treatment of Buruli ulcer (BU) disease in 2004 resulted in improvement in the management of the disease, confirmed by several studies, including a randomised controlled clinical trial (Nienhuis et al., Lancet 375:664–672, 2010).
Luganda: Okukozesa eddagala eritta obuwuka ng’obujjanjabi obusooka mu kujjanjaba endwadde y’amabwa g’oku lususu (BU) mu mwaka gwa 2004 kwaviirako okutumbula enzijanjaba y’endwadde eno, okwakakasibwa mu kunoonyereza okw’enjawulo, omuli n’okugezesa okw’okweroboza (Nienhuis et al., Lancet 375:664–672, 2010).
Yoruba: Ìmúwọlé awogba ààrùn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìtọ́jú onípò-kíní fún ààruǹ ọgbẹ́ inú Buruli (BU) ní ọdún 2004 yọrí sí ìdàgbàsókè nídì àmójútó ààrùn náà, léyìí tí ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ṣẹ̀rí sí, tí ó fi mọ́ àṣedáwò ìdèènà aláìfojúsọ ilé ìwòsàn (Nienhuis et al., Lancet 375:664–672, 2010).
Zulu: Ukwethulwa kwamakhambi alwisana namagciwane njengendlela yokuqala yokulashwa kwesifo i-Buruli ulcer(BU) ngonyaka wezi-2004 yaholela ukuthuthuka ekulawuleni isifo, kuqinisekiswa ucwaningo oluningana, kungahlaniswa nokuhlolwa kwase mtholampilo okulawuliwe okungahleliwe (Nienhuis et al., Lancet 375:664-672, 2010).
Hausa: Gabatar da maganin rigakafi a matsayin maganin farko na cutar mikin Buruli (BU) a cikin shekarar 2004 ya haifar da ingantawa a cikin kula da cutar, wanda aka tabbatar da shi ta hanyar bincike da yawa, ciki har da gwajin asibiti kara zube da aka sarrafa (Nienhuis da wasu, Lancet 375:664–672, 2010).
Northern Sotho: Go dirišwa ga dianthipayothiki bjalo ka kalafo ya mathomo ya bolwetši bja alesa bja Buruli (BU) ka 2004 go hlotše kaonafalo go taolo ya bolwetši, ye e tiišeditšwego ke dinyakišišo tše mmalwa, go akaretša diteko tša kalafo tše di laolwago tša taletšo ya bakgathatema ka go se kgetholle (Nienhuis et al., Lancet 375:664–672, 2010).
Amharic: በ2004 ለቡሩላይ አልሰር (ቡ.አ) በሽታ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ህክምና አንቲባዮቲኮች መሰጠታቸው የበሽታውን አያያዝ የማሻሻል ወጤት አሳይተዋል፤ ይህም ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት የዘፈቀደ ክሊኒካዊ ሙከራን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ጥናቶች ተረጋግጧል (ኒኑሁዊስ እና ሌሎች ፣ ላንሴት 375:664–672፣ 2010)።

Source: Despite successful outcomes with this treatment regimen, the healing process is still characterized by long hospital stays as a result of delayed healing, in a significant proportion of cases.
Luganda: Wadde ng’enzijanjaba eno yavaamu ebibala, okujjanjaba kukyetaagisa abalwadde okumala ebbanga eggwanvu mu ddwaliro olw’okulwawo okuwona emirundi egisinga.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àbájáde àṣeyọrí pẹ̀lú ìlànà ìtọ́jú yìí, ìgbésẹ̀ ìwòsàn rẹ̀ ṣì ní àbùdá dídúró pẹ́ ní ilé ìwòsàn, látàrí ìwòsàn tí kò yá, nínú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí iye rẹ̀ lápẹẹrẹ.
Zulu: Naphezu kwemiphumela eyimpumelelo ngalolu hlobo lokwelapha, ukululama kusabonakala ngokuhlala isikhathi eside esibhedlela ngenxa yokuphuza ukululama, ngenani elikhulu lezigameko.
Hausa: Duk da sakamako masu nasara da aka samu tare da wannan tsarin jiyya, tsarin warkarwa har yanzu yana da alaƙa da tsayin daka na asibiti sakamakon jinkirin warkarwa, a cikin adadi mai yawa.
Northern Sotho: Go sa lebelelwe dipoelo tša katlego ka sehlare se sa kalafo, tshepedišo ya go phodišo e sa lemogwa ka go dula nako telele sepetlele ka baka la titelego ya pholo, go palo ya godimo kudu ya malwetši.
Amharic: በዚህ የህክምና ስርአት የተሳኩ ውጤቶች ቢኖሩም ጉልህ መጠን ካላቸው ክስተቶች የፈውስ መዘግየት የተነሳ የፈውስ ሂደቱ አሁንም በረዥም ጊዜ የሆስፒታል ቆይታዎች ባህሪው ይታወቃል፡፡

Source: Clinical observations and subsequent research identified secondary infection of the BU lesions by other bacteria as a cause of wound healing delay, debunking the widely held belief that mycolactone, the macrolide toxin of Mycobacterium ulcerans, has antimicrobial activity and is preventing secondary infection of BU wounds.
Luganda: Ebyekalirizo by’obujjanjabi n’okunoonyereza okwaddirira byazuula ng’obulwadde obuleetebwa obuwuka obulala bu BU ne bukwata ku mabwa g’oku lususu bwe buviirako ekiwundu okulwawo okuwona, olwo ne kiggyawo endowooza abantu gye balina ennyo nti eddagala lya mycolactone ery’obutwa obuleetebwa obuwuka obuyitibwa Mycobacterium ulcerans, lirimu ekirungo ekitta obuwuka era nga liziyiza amabwa g’oku lususu okufuna obulwadde obulala.
Yoruba: Àkíyèsí àwọn Ìlé Ìwòsàn àti àwọn ìwádìí ṣèdámọ̀ ìkọlù àtẹ̀yìndé àwọn ojú ọgbẹ́ BU láti ọwọ́ àwọn batéríà mììràn gẹ́gẹ́ bí okùnfà àìyára náà, léyìí tí ó ń tako ìgbàgbọ́ tó kárí ayé lóríi pé máíkòlátọ̀, èròjà iwọ fún kòkòrò ulceran makobatéríà, ní atako ìṣe kòkòrò àìfojúrí àti ìdèènà ìkọlù àtẹ̀yìndé ojú ọgbẹ́ BU.
Zulu: Ukuhlola komtholampilo nocwaningo olwalandela lathola ukuthi ukutheleleka kwesibili ngezilonda ze-BU kwenziwa ngamanye amagciwane ikhona okubangela ukuphuza kokululama, echitha inkolelo ebhekwe kabanzi ukuthi i-mycolactone, ubuthi be-macrolide ne-Mycobacterium ulcerans, inomuthi wokulapha amagciwane futhi ivimbela ukutheleleka kwesibili ngezilonda ze-BU.
Hausa: Bincike na asibiti da bincike na gaba sun gano kamuwa da cuta ta biyu na ƙurajen BU ta wasu ƙwayoyin cuta a matsayin sanadin jinkirin warkar da raunuka, yana ƙaryata yardar da aka ɗauka cewa maikolakton, gubar da ƙwayoyin cuta na ruwa suke samarwa na nau’in bakteriya, yana da maganin rigakafi kuma yana hana kamuwa da cuta ta biyu na raunukan BU.
Northern Sotho: Ditekodišišo tša diteko tša kalafo le dinyakišišo tše di latelago tšeo di laeditšwego phetetšo ya tlaleletšo ya dišo tša BU ka dipaktheria tše dingwe bjalo ka seo se hlolago paktheria ya tiegišo ya go fola ga dišo, go ganetša kgopolo ye e tlwaelegilego ya gore mycolactone, macrolide toxin ya Mycobacterium ulcerans, e na le maatla a twantšho ya dimaekheropiale le gona e thibela phetetšo ye nngwe ya dišo tša BU.
Amharic: ማይኮላክቶን የተባለው የማይኮባክትሪየም አልሰራንስ ማክሮላይድ መርዝ የጸረ-ተህዋስያን ተግባሮች አሉት እንዲሁም የቡ.አ ጉዳቶችን ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ኢንፌክሽን ይከላከላል ተብሎ በሰፊው የሚታመነው አስተሳሰብ የተሳሳተ መሆኑን በማሳየት ክሊኒካዊ ምልከታዎች እና ተከታይ ምርምሮች የቡ.አ ቁስሎች በሌላ ባክቴሪያ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ መመረዝ ለቁስል ፈውስ መዘግየት መንስኤ መሆኑን ለይተዋል፡፡

Source: Secondary infection in BU disease is not well characterized, but the few studies, which described its occurrence identified Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa as the dominant bacterial species responsible for wound infection and provided evidence that delayed wound closure may be associated in some patients with a high wound bioburden.
Luganda: Okukwatibwa kw’endwadde endala eya BU si kutangaavu bulungi naye okunoonyereza okutono okwannyonnyola okubaawo kwakwo kwazuula akawuka k’omu muyitiro ogwa waggulu akayitibwa Staphylococcus aureus awamu n’akawuka akamanyiddwa nga Pseudomonas aeruginosa ng’obuwuka obusinga okuviirako ebiwundu okukwatibwa endwadde era ne kuwa n’obukakafu nti ebiwundu okulwawo okuziba kuyinza okuba nga kuva ku balwadde abamu ababa n’obuwuka obungi ku biwundu byabwe.
Yoruba: Wíwo àbùdá ìkọlù àtẹ̀yìndé nínú ààrùn BU kò ṣe dáadáa, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ìwádìí díẹ̀, tí ó ṣàpèjúwe ìwáyé rẹ̀ ṣe ìdámọ̀ kòkòrò tó ń fa kòkòrò inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti kòkòrò sédòmọ̀ná erujinósà gẹ́gẹ́ bí olúborí kòkòrò batéríà tí ó fa ìkọlù ojú ọgbẹ́ tí ó sì ń mú àwọn ohun tí ó fa ìpajúdé ojú egbò sẹ́yìn lè ní ìbáṣepọ̀ lára àwọn aláìsàn mìíràn tí wọ́n ní ojú ọgbẹ́ ńlá pẹ̀lú ẹrù kòkòrò batéríà.
Zulu: Ukutheleleka kwesibili esifweni se-BU akubonakali kahle, kodwa ucwaningo olumbalwa, ezichaze ukwenzeka kwakho kukhombe i-Staphylococcus aureus ne-Pseudomonas aeruginosa njengamagciwane avamile abhekene nokutheleleka kwezilonda lwaphinde laletha ubufakazi ukuthi ukuphuza kokuvaleka kwesilonda kwezinye zeziguli kungase kulanyaniswe nesilonda esinqwaba yamagciwane kuso.
Hausa: Cutar cututtuka ta biyu a cikin cutar BU ba ta da kyau, amma ‘yan binciken da suka bayyana abin da ya faru sun gano nau’in bakteruya da kuma nau’in bakteria a matsayin manyan nau'o’in ƙwayoyin cutar da take da alhakin kamuwa da rauni kuma sun ba da shaida cewa jinkirin rufe raunuka na iya haɗuwa a wasu majiyyata tare da babban haɗarin raunin adadin gurɓatattun ƙwayoyin cuta a abu.
Northern Sotho: Phetetšo ye nngwe go bolwetši bja BU ga e lemogwe gabotse, eupša dinyakišišo tše mmalwa, tše di hlalošitšego tlhago ya yona di lemogile Staphylococcus aureus le Pseudomonas aeruginosa bjalo ka mehuta ye dipaktheria tše kgolo tše di rwelego maikarabelo a phetetšo ya dišo le go fanego ka bohlatse bja gore go diegišwa ga go khupela ga dišo go ka amana le balwetši ba bangwe bao ba nago le ditwatši tša manganga godimo ga dišo.

Source: Standard guidelines for managing secondarily infected BU lesions are currently not available, but a common recourse for many clinicians is to prescribe additional antibiotics.
Luganda: Tewaliiwo bigobererwa eby’olugerero mu kujjanjaba BU agakwatiddwa endwadde endala, naye ng’abasawo abasinga batera okwongera abalwadde eddagala eddala eritta obuwuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìlànà tí ó rẹ́sẹ̀ walẹ̀ fún ìmójútó ìtẹ̀yìndé àwọn ojú ọgbẹ́ BU kò sí nilẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ báyìí, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀kọ́ irú ẹ tí ó wọ́pọ̀ fún púpọ̀ àwọn Òṣìṣẹ́ ìṣègùn òyìnbó yóò yan àwọn àfikún awogba ààrùn.

Hausa: Daidaitaccen jagororin kula da cututtukan BU masu kamuwa da cuta na biyu a halin yanzu ba su samuwa, amma hanyar gama-gari ga yawancin likitocin shi ne rubuta ƙarin maganin rigakafi.

Source: Studies describing the antibiogram of isolated secondarily infecting bacteria showed high levels of antibiotic resistance, indicating that antibiotic treatment may not be the best option to manage secondarily infected lesions.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okunnyonnyola obuwuka obukeberebwa mu malwaliro, obukwata abalwadde mu kiseera ky’obujjanjabi kwalaga ng’obuwuka obwo bugumira nnyo eddagala, ekiraga nti eddagala eritta obuwuka liyinza okuba nga si lye lyandisaanye okukozesebwa mu kujjanjaba amabwa agakwatiddwa endwadde endala.
Yoruba: Àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ṣe àpèjúwe àlàyé nípa kòkòrò batéríà aládàáwà atẹ̀yìndékọlù ṣàfihàn ìdèènà awogba ààrùn tó ga, tó sì ń fi hàn pé ìtọ́jú pẹ̀lú awogba ààrun le má jẹ́ ọ̀nà tí ó dára jùlọ lári ṣàmójútó ojú ọgbẹ́ ìkọlù àtẹ̀yìndé.
